about: The Ocean render benchmark (tests/ocean_render_browser.mjs, EvoOcean.bench at ?renderBench=1). A case is the benchmark world below at one population, one camera and one colour mode, paused at tick 0 (the counts are exact and no ecology changes), drawn through the normal page frame: oc_sync, packing, the render. The live cases unpause it at one step a frame and record the population every frame. walls: true is the site's fresh-visit default (CFG.FRESH).

cameras.dense: heads binned into 256-unit x / y cells; the fullest (row-major tie break); its mean head position and depth as the target; camera at target + [180, 80, 240]; flashlight off
cameras.follow: the smallest id, preferring a fish with barbels; camera at its head + [85, 32, 100]; then follow (the flashlight comes on with it); transitions settle

matrix: 3 counts x 3 cameras x 3 colour modes = 27 cells; paired baseline / candidate order B, C, C, B; draw-scope timing separate from whole-frame timing, never combined

profilerModes.off: the profiler off; rAF timestamps only (the baseline)
profilerModes.frame: cpu: frame (the whole frame callback: two clock reads)
profilerModes.spansGpu: cpu: every span, gpu: frame (one elapsed query around the submission, every 6th)
